steps.title: Prepare intranasal challenge solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute Alternaria alternata or recombinant IL‑33 in sterile 1× PBS to the desired dose (Alternaria: 25–50 µg per 40 µL; IL‑33: 10–50 ng per 40 µL). Prepare enough volume for all challenges within a one‑week period (e.g., three‑day model = volume for three days). Mix well, aliquot per day, and store at –20 °C. Thaw completely and mix before each use.

steps.title: Anesthetize and administer challenge
steps.instruction: Anesthetize a single 6–8‑week‑old female C57BL/6 mouse with inhaled isoflurane until breathing is slow and regular (avoid over‑anesthesia). Remove mouse from the chamber, hold upright, and pipette 40 µL of challenge solution onto the nose while the mouse inhales. Keep the mouse upright until the entire volume is inhaled. Repeat for each mouse and for each challenge day, keeping timing consistent.

steps.title: Collect bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL)
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse with CO₂, expose the trachea, and remove surrounding connective tissue. Using an 18 G needle kept parallel to the trachea, make a hole at the tracheal tip. Insert a pre‑made 21 G catheter (21 G needle threaded through catheter tubing before euthanasia) and flush 0.5 mL of 2 % BSA in PBS; wait ~10 s, then collect the first BAL draw into an individual FACS tube on ice. Repeat the flush four more times with 0.6 mL 2 % BSA each; pool these five draws in a second tube on ice. Store the first‑draw supernatant at –20 °C for ELISA; keep the cell pellets for flow cytometry.

steps.title: Harvest lungs
steps.instruction: After BAL, expose the chest, pierce and remove the diaphragm, cut through the middle of the rib cage, and open the cage to expose the lungs. Transfer the lungs into 1 mL RPMI (kept on ice).

steps.title: Process BAL samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge both the first‑draw tube and the pooled‑draw tube at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C. Transfer the first‑draw supernatant to a labeled Eppendorf tube and store at –20 °C. Aspirate the supernatant from the pooled tube without disturbing the pellet. Resuspend the first‑draw pellet in 500 µL FACS buffer, then combine with the pooled‑draw pellet.

steps.title: Digest lung tissue
steps.instruction: Place each lung in a gentleMACS C‑tube containing 2.5 mL lung digest buffer, 50 µL enzyme D, and 7.5 µL enzyme A (Miltenyi Lung Digest kit). Run the gentleMACS dissociator on the lung_01 program, ensure all tissue is in the buffer, then incubate at 37 °C for 30 min with end‑over‑end mixing. Run the dissociator on the lung_02 program, filter the suspension through a 70 µm filter into a 50 mL conical tube, wash with 2 mL RPMI, centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL RPMI.

steps.title: Count cells and allocate for stains
steps.instruction: Create a 1:100 dilution of each sample by mixing 5 µL sample with 495 µL FACS buffer. Acquire 100 µL of diluted sample on a Novocyte (high speed) and gate live cells (FSC/SSC) to calculate total cell number. Allocate cells as follows: BAL – 1 × 10⁶ cells per surface‑stain tube (if total <1 × 10⁶, stain the whole sample). Lung – 1 × 10⁶ cells per surface‑stain tube, 2 × 10⁶ cells per nuclear‑stain tube, and 1 × 10⁷ cells for cytokine‑stimulation culture. Prepare appropriate FMO and isotype controls using the same cell numbers and antibody concentrations.

steps.title: Culture cells for cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 1 × 10⁷‑cell tube at 500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 2 mL room‑temperature sterile T‑cell media. Add 4 µL cell stimulation cocktail + protein transport inhibitor (500×) per tube, mix, and dispense 200 µL into each well of a flat‑bottom 96‑well plate (10 wells = 1 × 10⁶ cells/well). Incubate at 37 °C for 3 h. After incubation, pool all wells, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 mL RPMI, and split evenly for cytoplasmic‑stain and isotype‑control tubes.

steps.title: Surface antibody staining
steps.instruction: Wash each tube with 400 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 50 µL FACS buffer containing Fc block; incubate 10–15 min on ice. Prepare master mixes (50 µL) in FACS buffer with the appropriate antibodies:

substeps.instruction: Granulocyte mix: CD11c‑FITC, SiglecF‑PE, CD45.2‑PerCP, GR‑1‑APC.
ILC mix: Lineage‑FITC (CD11c, NK1.1, CD5, FceR1α, TCRβ, TCRγδ), CD45.2‑PerCP, Thy1.2‑APC.

steps.title: Incubate surface stains and prepare compensation
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the appropriate master mix to each tube, cover with foil, and incubate 30 min at 4 °C. For compensation, stain 100 µL FACS buffer with 25 µL compensation beads and 1 µL of the corresponding fluorochrome‑conjugated antibody for 15–30 min. Wash stained samples with 400 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 150 µL FACS buffer. Run on the Novocyte. If analysis will occur the next day, fix cells in 100 µL 4 % PFA for 15 min, wash, and resuspend in 150 µL FACS buffer.

steps.title: Nuclear (intracellular) staining
steps.instruction: Prepare FOXP3 permeabilization working solution (1 part concentrate + 3 parts diluent). Add 300 µL of this solution to each sample, incubate 30 min in the dark at room temperature, mixing occasionally. Wash with 400 µL FOXP3 permeability buffer (1×), centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant. Stain with 100 µL FOXP3 permeability buffer (1×) plus the nuclear antibody (e.g., Ki‑67, Gata‑3) at the recommended dilution; cover with foil and incubate 30 min at 4 °C. Wash again with 400 µL FOXP3 permeability buffer, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 150 µL FACS buffer. Acquire on the Novocyte.

steps.title: Cytoplasmic staining
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL BD Cytofix/Cytoperm working solution to each sample, incubate 20 min in the dark at 4 °C. Wash with 400 µL BD permeability buffer, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant. Resuspend in 100 µL BD permeability buffer containing the cytoplasmic antibody (IL‑5, IL‑13) at the recommended dilution; cover with foil and incubate 30 min at 4 °C. Wash with 400 µL permeability buffer, centrifuge 500 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in 150 µL FACS buffer. Acquire on the Novocyte.

steps.title: Prepare FACS buffer and T‑cell media
steps.instruction: FACS buffer (store 4 °C, use ≤6 months): 1× PBS + 2 % FBS + 0.02 % sodium azide. T‑cell media (store 4 °C, use ≤4 weeks): RPMI + 10 % FBS + 1 % penicillin/streptomycin + 1 % L‑glutamine + 0.05 mM β‑mercaptoethanol.
